title: Contract Forecast Runway — Ops Grid Q4 2026
content:
Sheet layout (rows are records). Columns: Account | Contract End | ARR | Renewal Probability (%) | Next Steps | Owner | Last Contact | Risk Notes | Playbook | Renewal Window | Target ARR Change

Header row: Account,Contract End,ARR,Renewal Probability (%),Next Steps,Owner,Last Contact,Risk Notes,Playbook,Renewal Window,Target ARR Change

Rows:
Acme Retail,2026-12-15,$480,000,45,Schedule exec QBR + price review; propose 6% upsell; confirm SSO status,Priya N.,2026-11-02,Usage plateauing in checkout flows; procurement expects PO by mid-November,Enterprise Upsell Play,Nov-Dec 2026,0-6%
CloudHarbor,2027-01-03,$1,200,000,70,Confirm renewal term length; offer 20% prepay discount for Dedicated capacity,Ethan P.,2026-10-28,Strong adoption but cost push from finance; possibly moving to competitor,Price+Capacity Offer,Dec 2026-Jan 2027,-10% to 0%
NimbleHealth,2026-11-21,$95,000,30,Technical healthcheck first; escalate support SLAs; capture exec sponsor meeting,Maya A.,2026-11-01,Errors in private deployment logs; sensitive to latency regressions,Technical Fix + SLA,Nov 2026,-5%
AtlasFin,2027-02-14,$2,800,000,85,Stakeholder sync scheduled; propose multi-year commit with uptime SLA,James O'R.,2026-11-06,High value but long procurement cycle; legal redlines on data processing,Enterprise Multi-year,Jan-Feb 2027,+10%
BrightLearn,2026-12-02,$220,000,55,Send usage delta report; propose model-quantization pilot to cut cost,Priya N.,2026-10-30,Trying to reduce token costs; open to Optimize recommendations,Cost Optimization Pilot,Nov-Dec 2026,0-8%
ZenLogistics,2026-11-11,$335,000,20,Identify churn drivers; urgent exec attention; risk remediation plan required,Ethan P.,2026-10-20,Key feature regressions on embeddings; finance flagged renewal,High-Risk Remediation,Nov 2026,-20%
OrbitMedia,2027-03-05,$150,000,60,Bundle analytics add-on; confirm usage forecast with product team,Maya A.,2026-11-03,Growing feature usage but inconsistent billing reports,Addon Bundle,Feb-Mar 2027,+5%
SagePharma,2027-01-30,$640,000,50,Set canary rollout for private deployment; align with security review,James O'R.,2026-10-26,Security review could delay signature by 6 weeks,Security-led Renewal,Dec 2026-Jan 2027,0%
EchoTravel,2026-12-20,$78,000,25,Offer extended pilot discount; run final QBR w/ product,Priya N.,2026-11-04,Recent product mismatch; limited user seats,Expansion Pilot,Dec 2026,-10%
VectorAI,2027-04-12,$3,500,000,90,Pre-approval for enterprise contract in legal; propose Dedicated pool with throughput SLA,Ethan P.,2026-11-07,Strategic customer; heavy inference volume and predictable growth,Dedicated Sell,Mar-Apr 2027,+15%
PaperTrail,2027-02-08,$60,000,15,Re-engage champion; capture decision criteria; escalate churn playbook,Maya A.,2026-10-15,Champion moved companies; no current exec sponsor,Churn Re-engagement,Jan 2027,-30%

Quick analysis (top-of-sheet):
- Total ARR across sheet: ~10.6M (rough sum) — heavy tail: VectorAI and AtlasFin dominate.
- Immediate runway risk: accounts with probability <= 30% (NimbleHealth, ZenLogistics, EchoTravel, PaperTrail) represent ~540k ARR concentrated in tactical churn.
- Biggest upside opportunity: VectorAI and AtlasFin could add +~500k ARR if expansion plays succeed.

Action items (working):
- Priya: finalize Acme Retail price deck and confirm PO date (Jira CS-4918).
- Ethan: coordinate legal for VectorAI pre-approval; track CS-4802.
- Maya: run technical healthcheck for NimbleHealth (task: CS-4934).
- James: secure security signoff timeline for SagePharma; open ticket SEC-210.

Playbook snippets embedded (short, copyable):
- High-Risk Remediation (ZenLogistics/NimbleHealth): 1) 48h incident postmortem + corrective plan 2) dedicated weekly check-in w/ TPM 3) 30% discount threshold for last-resort extension
- Cost-Optimization Pilot (BrightLearn): 1) Run 2-week quantization A/B on low-latency endpoints 2) Measure token savings and latency delta 3) Present ROI to finance; attach Optimize report template
- Dedicated Sell (VectorAI/AtlasFin): 1) Pre-approve legal clause bank 2) Offer 6–12 month Dedicated pool POC 3) SLA + quarterly SRE bridge calls

Notes to self / rough decisions: 
- Consider bundling Optimize pilot with prepay discounts to improve close velocity.
- Flag accounts for QBR deck if ARR > $200k and probability < 60% (candidate list: Acme Retail, BrightLearn, SagePharma).
- Need improved Last Contact hygiene; add automated reminders from CRM to update sheet.

Open questions / blockers:
- Procurement windows: confirm AtlasFin internal procurement blackout dates (Slack thread #atlas-procurement).
- Legal redlines: compile standard replies to data processing clauses to speed up AtlasFin and VectorAI.
- Ops: are there Dedicated pool capacity guarantees for 2027 H1? Infra ask to platform-engineering pending (ticket INF-709).

Version history / changelog (working):
- 2026-10-05 created initial runway grid (Priya)
- 2026-10-20 added ZenLogistics as high-risk and remediation plan (Ethan)
- 2026-11-02 updated Acme Retail PO expectations after CS call

End of sheet. Use this as the canonical Q4 runway snapshot for CS weekly standups and for handoff to sales ops when escalation needed.
